==Description==
The '''Mummy''' was an enemy that exclusively appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health, but it was quite slow.

==Appearance==
The '''Mummy''' had green skin. Most of its body was covered in bandages. It wore a torn shirt and pants, held together by a dark brown belt. It walked with its left arm pointed forwards.

==Strategy==
*Cheap towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Golden Scout]] are recommended against this.
*As '''Mummies''' spawn in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be very useful against them.
